adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog.tsx onError, `const message = `${err.data?.code}: ${t(err.message)}`;` will always produce a truthy string (even if `err.data?.code` is undefined), so `showToast(message || t("unable_to_add_guests"), ...)` makes the fallback effectively unreachable. Also `t(err.message)` assumes `err.message` is a translation key; the diff shows server errors use keys like `emails_must_be_unique_valid`, but other TRPC errors could produce non-key messages, leading to confusing output rather than a clean translated fallback. This is a UX/robustness issue rather than a functional defect.
